About.p1: Backend Engineer with 3+ years building REST APIs, microservices and scalable systems with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Java and Go. I work end-to-end — from architecture and data modeling to AWS deploys, CI/CD and automations — with a focus on performance, security and code quality.

bullets: Led the backend technically — architecture, SQL modeling and stack decisions
Led backend development of the patient and prescription management systems
Built the inventory system in Python and Flask and started the internal system in Node.js and TypeScript
Set up AWS environment (EC2, RDS PostgreSQL, S3, ECR) with CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions
Implemented automations with n8n, WhatsApp and OpenAI, integrated with the database
Configured Ubuntu VPS and NGINX for application deploys
Structured the PR workflow, reviewed code and mentored the backend team
Built and maintained REST APIs in Node.js, shipping new endpoints and features
Worked on microservices architecture with messaging, MySQL, Docker and AWS
Wrote automated tests to ensure code quality
Optimized processes and fixed bugs across AWS integrations
Built integrations between Node.js applications and Oracle services using Express and NestJS
Implemented secure RESTful APIs following best practices
Used Docker for deployment and MongoDB and PostgreSQL for storage
Wrote unit tests with Jest and end-to-end tests
Automated personalized email campaigns with Python and Pandas
Delivered Salesforce e-commerce features with Node.js, HTML and CSS
